preconditions: The operations specialist's bound provider snapshot has been sliced (Jira + Confluence + Slack sections present or explicitly empty)
Provider bindings and filters have been enforced at read time before the slice reaches analysis

postconditions.description: Every missing-work finding cites the requirement id and the empty coverage
Every timeline-risk finding cites its evidence (issue id, due date, blocking chain)
Every proposal names the provider write kind and traces to an uncovered requirement
No load-bearing claim is present without a source id; unknowns are marked, never invented

description: Recurring TPM briefing produced by the operations specialist over its bound Jira + Confluence + Slack snapshot: PRD-versus-epic coverage, timeline risk, misalignment, and approval-gated ticket proposals.
